verdict.rationale:
Devin's docs describe Devin Review, which performs automated first-pass PR reviews checking correctness and org conformance, plus CI/CD integration to respond to static-analysis findings (SonarQube, Fortify, Veracode) and Auto-Fix iterating on CI failures — directly enabling developers to inspect diffs and run checks before merge. This is corroborated by explicit SDLC integration workflow docs, not just a single mention.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence confirming Devin Review's diff-inspection quality in practice, and detail on how diffs are surfaced/inspected by the developer (UI specifics) beyond docs claims.
